text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ...Ooh, my legs are feeling the
burn.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Oguri's unstoppable... How can she dash straight to the cafeteria like that after running long-distance?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait... yeah, chin up, Chiyono O! "Spring
comes
again for winter flower buds"!
Flowers that bear
the winter will live to
blossom in spring!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'm gonna take it easy and use the
day to
do some thorough stretches and
reflection! Never
give up, Chiyono O!
